## Context
The create sequence must survive process restart without duplicate Jira issues, preserve index-lag grace, and release dependent links/children only after create and binding confirmation are proven.

## Outcome
Run the complete Cloud/DC crash-restart sequence twice, prove exactly one remote issue and one confirmed binding, then make coordinated create authoritative behind one internal family rollback selector.

## Plan
1. Compose pending, create, containment, confirmation, and RP-02 keyed/keyless recovery across fresh process/store instances.
2. Preserve keyed recovery with zero search and keyless recovery with both three misses and 3600 seconds; one recovery failure cannot stop unrelated tickets.
3. Hold create-before-link and parent-before-child dependents until proven create/confirmation; preserve tombstones, filters, and read-only modes.
4. Venue-gate Cloud/DC verified-fake crash/restart tests, then switch the internal create-family default. Never run legacy and coordinator creates together.
5. Preserve exact per-ticket tally, logs, known-key safety abort, and rollback by re-observation.

## Testing
Duplicate probes execute every fault cut twice with fresh state. Dependency and filter tables assert zero early effects and independent continuation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every Cloud/DC crash-restart fault cut converges to exactly one remote issue and one confirmed forward/reverse binding.
- [x] Keyed recovery performs zero search.
- [x] Keyless negative search requires both three misses and 3600 seconds.
- [x] Per-entry recovery failure does not stop unrelated tickets.
- [x] Links and children wait for proven create/confirmation, while tombstones, filters, and read-only modes remain effective.
- [x] Create has one coordinator route and one internal legacy rollback value with no dual-send.

## Out of scope
Final removal of legacy create helpers remains S5.
